title: Homogeneous product projection in the graded tensor algebra
statement: Let j:Z→X be a closed immersion, L invertible, J=j.ker with J²=0 [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-invertible-module, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Fix n≥0, a TensorGradedPresentation T [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation], and canonical comparison data D=(a_r,k_r) [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Put N=(j^*L)^n, and for y:O_Z→N^(r+1) put c(y)=T.c_(n(r+1))((y;a_r^(-1))(1)), using the pushforward identification of sections [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For e≥0, f:O_Z→N and x:O_Z→N^(e+1), projection to degree n(e+2) of c(f^⊗1)c(x) is (((λ_(O_Z))^(-1);f⊗x);a_(e+1)^(-1))(1). This is an equality of quotient sections, with no cohomology boundary or action assertion.
